create_padded_room: create a PaddedRoom instance with a given room size and optional wall padding
regenerate_maze: regenerate the PaddedRoom maze with random objects and agent spawn positions
get_entity_layer: get the entity_layer TextGrid property showing maze walls, objects, and spawn tokens
get_variations_layer: get the variations_layer TextGrid property for maze variation tracking
get_maze_dimensions: get the width and height properties of a PaddedRoom including padding
